listing.name: Skylanders Giants — Giants Recompiled (TheBiemGamer)
listing.summary: Upstream describes early gameplay. Modes other than Story have not been tested. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own Xbox 360 Skylanders Giants version 1.0 ISO or extracted folder. Check the exact hash in upstream’s source validation before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use GiantsRecompSetup.exe to import your own disc. A real USB portal is optional; a virtual portal is supported. Linux requires a source build with experimental Vulkan support.

warnings: Upstream describes early gameplay. Modes other than Story have not been tested.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
